crossRefs.note: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

translations.web: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
translations.bsb: And the waters prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.
translations.kjv: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
translations.asv: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.
